phases.job: Your team's Project, my_project, was made with an older Toolbox. You have downloaded the new one, main/. Bring the Project up to date with it, every change it asks for made. Your Dev Database is mart_dev, and your Prod Database is team_prod. Each new table you make goes in the folder /data/team/<its database>.db/<its name>, such as /data/team/mart_dev.db/weekly; a table someone else made stays where it is.
